description: This file defines extension methods for integrating MessagePack serialization into Orleans serialization pipeline. It provides methods to register MessagePack serializers, configure options, and register necessary supporting services.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISerializerBuilder to add MessagePack serialization support.

methods.name: AddMessagePackSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add MessagePack serializer support to the serializer builder, with optional custom serializability, copyability predicates, and serializer options.

methods.name: AddMessagePackSerializer
methods.description: Overload of the extension method that additionally accepts a configuration delegate to customize MessagePack codec options.
